name: as-told-to
title_zh: 只记你说过的话，不替你补半句的人生访谈录
tagline_zh: 一场一场地采访你或你父母的人生，逐字稿原样留档，另出一份下次接着问的笔记；成不成书随你，档案先归你自己。
tagline_en: Interviews you, or your parent, session by session; keeps the verbatim transcript untouched and a separate working note for next time. Whether it becomes a book is your call — the archive is yours either way.
desc_en: A deep life-story interviewer for Claude and Codex — your story, in your words, in plain files you own. Never invents a word of your life. Free, MIT.
why_zh: 不许递一个细节让老人点头确认：「大概 2003 年冬天吧」进待核清单，正文写「我不确定」。
why_en: It will not hand the elder a detail to nod at. "Probably winter 2003" goes on the verify list, and the record itself says "2003 or 2004 — I'm not certain."
limit_zh: 它只采访在场的本人，不替不在场的人写传记，也拒绝改写成简历、领英简介或创始人故事。情绪一上来就全停：只给「留在这里／换话题／今天到这」三个选项，一个追问都不许有。仓库 dev/ 目录里抄了同行的整份 skill 当对照，安装时别一起拷进去。
limit_en: It only interviews the person in the room, refuses to write a biography of someone absent, and declines to convert the corpus into a resume, LinkedIn bio or founder story. When emotion rises it stops entirely, offering only stay here / change the subject / done for today, with no question about what surfaced. The repo's dev/ folder contains other authors' full skills copied in as prior art — don't install that part.
title_en: Life-story interviewer that writes only your words
